name: subscribe_github_ci
description: Subscribe this conversation to terminal GitHub CI results on one branch. Waits until every check run and commit-status context on a commit is terminal, then delivers one commit-wide result: success when none failed, or failure with the failed check names. Delivers only when the commit is still the head of the subscribed branch at delivery time; results for commits superseded by a newer push are dropped (the newer head notifies on its own CI). Fork PRs and branchless status events are not covered. Failures always deliver; a success delivers only as this subscription's first result or when it flips a previously delivered failure — repeated greens are not delivered. Subscribing to the repository's default branch (e.g. main) is one-shot: it delivers the next terminal result on that branch and then closes itself, so it cannot be used to watch every merge to the default branch. To wait for a PR's CI, subscribe to the PR's head branch instead. After subscribing, state what you are waiting for and end your turn; the event arrives as a follow-up notification in this conversation.
